reviews.comment: This class is known to be hard but this professor makes it more difficult. She lectures in complete monotone and doesn't interact with her classes at all. The lectures are jam packed and she doesn't even give you time to take notes. I didn't even sign up to take her and I was in her class. Impossible to understand material because she's so bland.

This class was all online this semester so you had to learn through prerecorded lectures. If you don't do everything she provides you with it is difficult to make a good grade. She does great lectures and does tell you everything you need to know, it is just up to you if you actually do everything. Great prof, but you have to put the work in!
She goes by Morgan Moore if you want more reviews.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: One of the worst classes i have ever taken, not because of the course itself but because of the prof. She gives easy examples in class and the tests are extremely hard. She has no sympathy for anyone ever. She treats her students like they should already know everything there is to know about accounting. Would not recommend.

Class is too difficult. Theres a lack of organization. The exams just stick out like a sore thumb; there are entire concepts and vocabulary not covered in in-class, notes, online lectures, nor the textbook. Online lectures are minimal. Prof also has a slightly bad attitude. Point based class, 3 tests (no curves), 12 homeworks, and a minor project.

Lectures were very clear and made the material easy to understand. She puts follow-along notes online that make the lectures easy to follow. The online material also helped if you didn't want to go to office hours. The class builds on itself so keep up with reading and practice and you should be fine.

This is a seriously difficult class. Getting a B is doable with lots of work, getting an A is almost impossible. Tests and homework dont reflect the material taught in class. If you want more info she goes by Morgan Moore, not Clarke. Most of those reviews are about ACCT 229 though. Shes very understanding of things but shes not an awful person.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class felt more difficult than it needed to be. This was due in part by this being a hybrid class. We met once a week and we tried to cover as much as we could; but theres too much content to meet once a week for. The online portion of the lectures are unhelpful. 3 exams, very hard (49% of class failed 2nd exam). Shes good; just not enough.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria
